Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the lineage from the Wikipedia source—William de Beauchamp’s father is Thomas Beauchamp, 11th Earl of Warwick, making Thomas the paternal grandfather. The Planner instead jumped one generation too far and named Guy de Beauchamp, 10th Earl of Warwick (the great-grandfather).
